title: HSK 1.2 · 现在, 觉得, 重要, 正在, 马上
focus: 在 · 不 · 就 · 个 · 和 · 说 · 要 · 好 · 会 · 也 · 都 · 对 · 到 · 上 · 很 · 去 · 她 · 着 · 想 · 给 · 看 · 现在 · 找 · 觉得 · 看到 · 找到 · 重要 · 正 · 得到 · 正在 · 身上 · 晚上 · 晚 · 重 · 记得 · 身体 · 出去 · 她们 · 马上
body:
Everyday verbs (在, 说, 看, 找, 给) and the result endings 到 and 得 that attach to them: 看到, 找到, 得到, 觉得, 记得. 上 and 身 also come back several times.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 到 | dào | arrive; (after verb) succeed in | 看到, 找到, 得到 |
| 得 | dé / de | get; (suffix) | 觉得, 得到, 记得 |
| 上 | shàng / shang | up, on | 身上, 晚上, 马上 |
| 在 | zài | at; (doing) now | 现在, 正在 |
| 正 | zhèng | straight; right now | 正在 |
| 重 | zhòng | heavy | 重要 |
| 身 | shēn | body | 身上, 身体 |
| 看 | kàn | look (手 over 目) | 看到 |

## Watch out

- 得 is dé in 得到 but toneless de in 觉得 and 记得.
- 重 is zhòng (heavy) here; chóng means "again" (重新).
- 着 is toneless zhe after verbs (看着) but zháo in 睡着 (fall asleep).
- 找 (zhǎo, look for) vs 我 (wǒ, I): 找 has the 扌 hand on the left.
- 不 becomes bú before a 4th tone: 不是 búshì, 不要 búyào.

cards.Example: 我在家。 wǒ zài jiā: I'm at home.
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 才 cái for the sound. 在 vs 再 (zài, again): same sound, different job

cards.Example: 我不要。 wǒ bú yào: I don't want it.
cards.Notes: The basic 'not'; becomes bú before a 4th tone (不是 búshì)

cards.Example: 就是他! jiù shì tā: That's him!
cards.Notes: 京 jīng (capital) + 尤 yóu

cards.Example: 我要两个。 wǒ yào liǎng ge: I want two.
cards.Notes: 人 roof + a vertical stroke; simplified from 個 (亻 + 固). Toneless ge after numbers

cards.Example: 他和她都在。 tā hé tā dōu zài: He and she are both here.
cards.Notes: 禾 grain + 口 mouth; 和 only joins nouns, never two sentences

cards.Example: 他说不去。 tā shuō bú qù: He says he's not going.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 兑 duì

cards.Example: 你要这个吗? nǐ yào zhège ma: Do you want this one?
cards.Notes: 覀 on top of 女; 要 vs 耍 (shuǎ, play), which has 而 on top

cards.Example: 这个很好。 zhège hěn hǎo: This one's good.
cards.Notes: 女 woman + 子 child = good. Read hào in 爱好 (hobby)

cards.Example: 他会做饭。 tā huì zuòfàn: He can cook.
cards.Notes: 人 roof over 云; 会 vs 去: different tops, both end in 厶

cards.Example: 我也去。 wǒ yě qù: I'm going too.
cards.Notes: A simple 3-stroke character; it's the right side of 他, 她, 地

cards.Example: 他们都不在。 tāmen dōu bú zài: None of them are here.
cards.Notes: 阝 on the right means 'city'; also read dū in 首都 (capital)

cards.Example: 对,是我。 duì, shì wǒ: Yes, it's me.
cards.Notes: 又 hand + 寸 (simplified from 對). 对不起 = sorry

cards.Example: 我到了。 wǒ dào le: I'm here.
cards.Notes: 至 arrive + 刂 (刀 dāo, knife) for the sound

cards.Example: 上一个是我的。 shàng yí ge shì wǒ de: The previous one was mine.
cards.Notes: Mirror image of 下: the short stroke points up

cards.Example: 我很好。 wǒ hěn hǎo: I'm fine.
cards.Notes: 彳 step + 艮 gèn; just borrowed for 'very'. 很 vs 跟 (gēn) vs 狠 (hěn, fierce)

cards.Example: 你去不去? nǐ qù bu qù: Are you going or not?
cards.Notes: 去 = 土 over 厶; 去 vs 云 (yún, cloud), which has 二 on top

cards.Example: 她也在。 tā yě zài: She's here too.
cards.Notes: 女 woman + 也 yě; sounds exactly like 他

cards.Example: 门开着。 mén kāi zhe: The door's open.
cards.Notes: Top like 羊 + 目 eye. 着 vs 看: both have 目 at the bottom. zháo in 睡着 (fall asleep)

cards.Meaning: to think; to want to; to miss
cards.Example: 我想回家。 wǒ xiǎng huíjiā: I want to go home.
cards.Notes: 相 xiāng for the sound + 心 heart underneath

cards.Example: 给你。 gěi nǐ: Here you go.
cards.Notes: 纟 silk + 合 hé (together)

cards.Example: 我看一下。 wǒ kàn yíxià: Let me take a look.
cards.Notes: A hand 手 over an eye 目: shading your eyes to look

cards.Example: 我现在就去。 wǒ xiànzài jiù qù: I'm going right now.
cards.Notes: 现 = 王 jade + 见 jiàn for the sound

cards.Example: 你找谁? nǐ zhǎo shéi: Who are you looking for?
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 戈 halberd. 找 vs 我 (wǒ): 我 has no separate hand radical

cards.Example: 我觉得很好。 wǒ juéde hěn hǎo: I think it's good.
cards.Notes: 觉 sense, feel (contains 见 see) + 得 get = to feel, think

cards.Example: 我看到他了。 wǒ kàndào tā le: I saw him.
cards.Notes: 看 look + 到 arrive = the look reaches it: to see

cards.Example: 我找到了! wǒ zhǎodào le: Found it!
cards.Notes: 找 look for + 到 arrive = the search succeeds: find

cards.Example: 这个很重要。 zhège hěn zhòngyào: This is important.
cards.Notes: 重 heavy + 要 needed = weighty and needed: important

cards.Example: 时间正好。 shíjiān zhènghǎo: The timing is just right.
cards.Notes: 一 line + 止 foot: a foot headed straight for its goal, so straight, correct

cards.Example: 我得到了。 wǒ dédào le: I got it.
cards.Notes: 得 get + 到 arrive = to obtain. 得 is dé here, not de

cards.Example: 我正在吃饭。 wǒ zhèngzài chīfàn: I'm eating right now.
cards.Notes: 正 just + 在 at = right at it: in the middle of doing

cards.Example: 我身上没钱。 wǒ shēnshang méi qián: I have no money on me.
cards.Notes: 身 body + 上 on = on the body, on you

cards.Example: 今天晚上我们去吃饭。 jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen qù chīfàn: We're going out to eat tonight.
cards.Notes: 晚 = 日 + 免 miǎn for the sound

cards.Example: 太晚了。 tài wǎn le: It's too late.
cards.Notes: 日 sun + 免 miǎn for the sound. 晚 vs 免 vs 兔 (tù, rabbit)

cards.Example: 这个很重。 zhège hěn zhòng: This is heavy.
cards.Notes: zhòng = heavy (重要); chóng = again (重新). 重 vs 里: 重 has a stroke on top

cards.Example: 你记得我吗? nǐ jìde wǒ ma: Do you remember me?
cards.Notes: 记 note down (讠 + 己 jǐ for the sound) + 得 get = remember

cards.Example: 你身体好吗? nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma: How's your health?
cards.Notes: 身 body + 体 body (亻 + 本 root) = body, health

cards.Example: 我们出去吃吧。 wǒmen chūqu chī ba: Let's eat out.
cards.Notes: 出 out + 去 go (away from the speaker) = go out

cards.Example: 她们是姐妹。 tāmen shì jiěmèi: They're sisters.
cards.Notes: 她 she (女 woman + 也) + 们 plural

cards.Example: 我马上来。 wǒ mǎshàng lái: I'll be right there.
cards.Notes: 马 horse + 上 on = on horseback, so 'right away'
